name: ArtCraft

sentences.text: Someone just used AI to rebuild seven Adobe apps.
Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom, even After Effects.
The Photoshop one already has 58 tools and works with real PSD files.
They run on Mac, Windows, Linux, and even in your browser.
And every single one is free and open source.

caption:
Someone used AI to rebuild 7 Adobe apps, and they're all free 👀

PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, LightCraft, EffectCraft and more. Open source, runs on Mac, Windows, Linux and in the browser. Still early alpha, so expect bugs.

Comment ARTCRAFT and I'll DM you the links.

#ai #adobe #photoshop #aftereffects #opensource #aitools #editing
summary_cs: ArtCraft: někdo pomocí AI (Claude) přepsal 7 aplikací Adobe jako open source zdarma (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, LightCraft, EffectCraft…). Zatím alfa verze.
script: Someone just used AI to rebuild seven Adobe apps. Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom, even After Effects. The Photoshop one already has 58 tools and works with real PSD files. They run on Mac, Windows, Linux, and even in your browser. And every single one is free and open source. It's still early, so expect bugs. Comment ARTCRAFT and I'll send you the links.
